C-R6.name: equation residual norm
C-R6.criterion: relative L2 residual < 1e-6 at the pole

C-R7.name: center-basis stability
C-R7.criterion: pole shift < 1e-3 under center start-radius or series-order variation

C-R9.name: branch continuation
C-R9.criterion: continuous path from seed to pole tracked or grid-deformation evidence

C-R10.name: kinetic/flux consistency
C-R10.criterion: outgoing flux direction confirmed by Wronskian current sign

tolerance_policy: frozen before first SSZ root; changes require a version bump and preservation of the failed version
